stories.title: Visite du pape en France : les violences sexuelles au sein de l’Eglise, une « plaie encore ouverte » pour Léon XIV

en.title: Pope's visit to France: sexual violence within the Church, an "still open wound" for Leon XIV
en.summary: The Pope is scheduled to meet seven victims in Lourdes on September 27. French bishops have been leading on the issue of systemic sexual abuse, though advocacy groups now report a retreat from previous progress.

stories.title: Visite de Léon XIV en France : après Paris, le pape s’est recueilli à Lourdes devant une foule de fidèles

en.title: Pope Leon XIV's visit to France: after Paris, the pontiff prayed at Lourdes before a crowd of faithful
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV celebrated a large mass at Place de la Concorde in Paris before traveling to the Lourdes grotto in the evening, where he entrusted France to the protection of the Virgin Mary.

stories.title: Visite de Léon XIV en France : de Paris, avec la messe géante place de la Concorde, à Lourdes, les images de cette journée de ferveur

en.title: Pope Leon XIV's visit to France: from Paris, with the giant mass at Place de la Concorde, to Lourdes, images of this day of devotion
en.summary: On the second day of his apostolic journey in France, Pope Leon XIV traveled through Paris and celebrated an outdoor mass at Place de la Concorde before praying at the Lourdes grotto in the evening.

stories.title: Visite du pape en France : revivez la messe célébrée par Léon XIV sur la place de la Concorde devant 800 000 spectateurs

en.title: Pope's visit to France: relive the mass celebrated by Pope Leon XIV at Place de la Concorde before 800,000 spectators
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV traveled down the Champs-Élysées in his papal vehicle before celebrating a large mass at Place de la Concorde, a highlight of his second day visiting France.

stories.title: Léon XIV en France : après Paris, le pape est arrivé à Lourdes

en.title: Leon XIV in France: after Paris, the pope arrives in Lourdes
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV, who arrived in France on Friday, is continuing his four-day visit to the country. Saturday's main event includes an outdoor mass in central Paris.

stories.title: «C’est le patron» : à Paris, Léon XIV fait messe et masse sur la place de la Concorde

en.title: "He's the boss": in Paris, Leon XIV holds mass and gathers crowds at Place de la Concorde
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV celebrated an outdoor service on Saturday, September 26, before approximately 800,000 people gathered on the Champs-Élysées. The diverse crowd represented varying perspectives and interests.

stories.title: "Tout ce monde, ça renforce notre foi" : sur les Champs-Elysées, la ferveur des 800 000 fidèles devant la messe du pape Léon XIV

en.title: "All these people strengthen our faith": on the Champs-Élysées, the fervor of 800,000 faithful at Pope Leon XIV's mass
en.summary: Many attendees woke early to witness the mass celebrated by Pope Leon XIV at Place de la Concorde. The large gathering demonstrated strong devotion among participants.

stories.title: Marche pour le climat : des milliers de personnes mobilisées partout en France

en.title: March for the climate: thousands of people mobilized throughout France
en.summary: Thousands of people participated in climate marches across France on Saturday, following a summer marked by heat records and wildfires. Around 260 demonstrations were organized nationwide to demand urgent climate action measures.

stories.title: Le pape Léon XIV s'adresse à la jeunesse lors de sa messe géante à Paris

en.title: Pope Leo XIV addresses youth during his giant mass in Paris
en.summary: During a large-scale mass held at Place de la Concorde in Paris attended by 700,000 people according to the Vatican, Pope Leo XIV specifically addressed young people.

stories.title: La visite de Léon XIV à Paris relance le débat sur la place des femmes dans l’Église

en.title: Leon XIV's visit to Paris reignites debate on the place of women in the Church
en.summary: The papal visit to Paris has brought attention to questions of governance, worship, and equality between women and men within the Church.

stories.title: Visite du pape à Paris : acclamé par une foule immense, Léon XIV descend l'avenue des Champs-Elysées à bord de sa papamobile

en.title: Pope's visit to Paris: acclaimed by a huge crowd, Leo XIV travels down the Champs-Élysées in his popemobile
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV received a warm welcome from thousands of faithful as he traveled along the Champs-Élysées between the Arc de Triomphe and Place de la Concorde.

stories.title: Après le succès populaire de sa messe géante à Paris, le pape Léon XIV poursuit sa visite à Lourdes

en.title: After the popular success of his giant mass in Paris, Pope Leo XIV continues his visit to Lourdes
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV celebrated a large mass attended by approximately 800,000 faithful in Paris before traveling to Lourdes on Saturday evening for the second stage of his visit to France. He entrusted France to the protection of the Virgin Mary during his time there.

stories.title: Il était plusieurs fois : une jeunesse désunie à la rencontre de Léon XIV

en.title: It was several times: a divided youth meeting Leon XIV
en.summary: A diverse crowd of believers gathered on September 26 in the streets of Paris for the Pope's visit. The gathering reflected the various currents dividing the French Church.

stories.title: Trêve papale. L’édito de Bruno Jeudy

en.title: Papal truce. The editorial by Bruno Jeudy
en.summary: This is an editorial piece by Bruno Jeudy, deputy director of La Tribune Dimanche.

stories.title: Valérie Pécresse s'intercale, Marion Maréchal et Marine Le Pen s'enlacent... les politiques au premier rang de la messe du pape

en.title: Valérie Pécresse interjects, Marion Maréchal and Marine Le Pen embrace... politicians in the front row of the Pope's mass
en.summary: The Pope's mass held on September 26 at Place de la Concorde in Paris drew several hundred thousand worshippers. Numerous political figures, including several presidential candidates, attended the event.

stories.title: À Paris, la grande concorde nationale autour de Léon XIV

en.title: In Paris, great national unity around Leo XIV
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV drew large crowds during his first visit to Paris and maintained a consensus approach despite disagreeing with end-of-life legislation.

stories.title: Pékin et Washington refusent de ralentir sur l'IA

en.title: Beijing and Washington refuse to slow down on AI
en.summary: Despite recent incidents and calls for regulation, Xi Jinping and Donald Trump have committed this week to continuing unrestricted development of the artificial intelligence sector.
